name: smwpatches-lava-fix-v-1
title: Lava Fix v. 1.0
description:
Prevents most sprites from walking onto sloped lava tiles, and not getting killed. Sprites that are invulnerable to stars / throw blocks are exceptions to this ; they need to be invulnerable to work correctly.
Does not fix the sideways lava tiles (15A & 15B) yet. Credit not needed.
